title: Compatible connected finite abelian cover tower
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme and $I$ a small nonempty directed preordered set. A connected abelian cover tower consists of an inverse system $(X_i\to U)$ of objects of $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], each with nonempty connected affine source and finite etale structure morphism [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]; an inverse system of finite abelian groups $\Gamma_i$ with surjective transition homomorphisms; and actions of $\Gamma_i$ on $X_i$ over $U$, equivariant under transitions. It includes the isomorphisms $X_i[\Gamma_i]\simeq X_i\times_UX_i$ given by $(x,g)\mapsto(x,gx)$, using the profinite test objects [def-sfb-profinite-test-objects] (for a finite group these are disjoint labelled copies). It further includes a cone $X\to X_i$ whose underlying scheme cone is a limit, with $X$ a nonempty connected object of $U_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $X\to U$ a singleton proetale covering, a limit cone $G\to\Gamma_i$ in profinite groups, and an isomorphism $X[G]\simeq X\times_UX$ with first projection $X[G]\to X$. Its second projection, followed by $X\to X_i$, equals the map $X[G]\to X_i[\Gamma_i]\to X_i$ induced by the two limit projections and the finite comparison. Thus compatibility is imposed on the whole profinite parameter schemes.
